quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #12
										  					
  

50 Questions • Passing Score 40

questions.question: Traffic signals sometimes show arrows to control turns from specific lanes. A green arrow:

options.text: Is used only on one-way streets.
Means the same as a green light, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.
Means you may proceed only if a circular green light is also showing.
Points the way to an airport.

questions.correctAnswerText: Means the same as a green light, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means the same as a circular green light. However, traffic in that lane must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: When stopped for a traffic violation or equipment check, you must show:
questions.explanation: You must carry and show your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance when stopped. You need all three documents in your vehicle when driving.

questions.question: When driving in traffic, it is safest to:

options.text: Change your speed often to stay alert.
Drive at the same speed as other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive at the same speed as other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers go much faster or slower than other vehicles. Drive at the same speed as surrounding traffic, but always stay within the speed limit.

questions.question: When a curb is painted ____, no stopping, standing, or parking is allowed at any time.
questions.explanation: Curb colors show parking rules. A red curb means no stopping, standing, or parking is allowed at any time.

questions.question: Lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are separated by ____ lines.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines divide traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light means:

options.text: Stop, look for traffic, then go if the road is clear.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Speed up to clear the intersection quickly.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to enter the road or driveway from your current direction. If you see this sign, turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: You can legally pass on the right side of another vehicle if:

options.text: The vehicle is turning left and there is a passing lane available.
You drive off the pavement to pass.
You are on a narrow bridge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is turning left and there is a passing lane available.
questions.explanation: You may pass on the right when a vehicle is turning left and an extra lane is available. You may also pass on the right on multilane roads with two or more lanes in the same direction. Never drive off the pavement to pass another vehicle.

questions.question: U-turns are not allowed:

options.text: In a curve in the road.
On a hill where you cannot see 500 feet ahead in both directions.
Near a sign that prohibits U-turns.

questions.explanation: U-turns are not permitted in curves, on hills with less than 500 feet of visibility in both directions, or near signs that prohibit U-turns.

questions.question: Which of the following does NOT happen after drinking alcohol?

options.text: Your judgment of speed and distance gets worse.
You calm down and concentrate better.

questions.correctAnswerText: You calm down and concentrate better.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your reaction time, reduces your vision, distorts your judgment of speed and distance, makes you less alert, and increases risky behavior. It does not help you calm down or concentrate better.

questions.question: How can stress affect your driving?

options.text: It reduces your ability to focus on driving.
It decreases your chances of having an accident.
It causes you to fall asleep at the wheel.
It makes you more aware of others around you.

questions.correctAnswerText: It reduces your ability to focus on driving.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions can harm your driving. You may not drive well if you are worried, excited, afraid, angry, or sad. Stress reduces your focus on driving. It is better to wait before driving when you feel emotionally upset.

questions.question: To pass a slower vehicle on a two-lane road with traffic going both ways, you must:

options.text: Flash your lights at oncoming traffic.
Use the lane for oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the lane for oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: On a two-lane road with traffic both ways, you must use the oncoming traffic lane to safely pass. Only pass if it is safe and legal to do so.

questions.question: You are waiting in line at a stop sign. After the vehicles ahead pass through, there is no cross traffic. What should you do?

options.text: You may go through without stopping again.
You must stop at the sign or line before going forward.
You may slowly roll past the sign.
You may follow the vehicle ahead without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must stop at the sign or line before going forward.
questions.explanation: You must always make a complete stop at a stop sign and check for traffic before proceeding. Do not let other drivers pressure you to skip this step.

questions.question: As alcohol builds up in your blood, it:

options.text: Gets broken down faster by your body.

questions.explanation: As alcohol builds up in your system, it slows your reactions, makes you feel too confident, and causes you to make more driving mistakes.

questions.question: Driving much slower than the speed limit is:
questions.explanation: Unless road conditions require it, driving much slower than the posted speed limit is dangerous. Slower drivers force other drivers to take unsafe risks when passing.

questions.question: Larger vehicles have:

options.text: The same blind spots as smaller vehicles.

questions.explanation: The bigger the vehicle, the bigger the blind spots. Large trucks and SUVs have areas near the back that the driver cannot see in the mirrors.

questions.question: A driver turning left must yield to a bicyclist coming from the opposite direction.
questions.explanation: When turning left, you must yield to oncoming bicycles the same way you yield to oncoming cars. Keep your wheels straight while waiting and proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: When you see a steady red traffic light, you should:

options.text: Drive through if there is no traffic.
Keep going because you have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is watching.

questions.explanation: A red light means you must stop completely. Driving through a red light is illegal and very dangerous. You may turn right on red only if there is no sign forbidding it.

questions.question: When riding in a vehicle, young children:

options.text: May be safely held by an adult.
Will be safe standing on the floor in the back.
Will not be hurt in an accident because they are small.
Must never stand in the vehicle while it is moving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must never stand in the vehicle while it is moving.
questions.explanation: Children who are too small for regular seatbelts need special child seats. No adult is strong enough to hold a child safely during a crash or sudden stop. Always keep children properly secured in a seat.

questions.question: You are driving up a hill and see a heavy truck ahead. You should know that:

options.text: The truck may be going slower than the speed limit.
It may not be safe to pass the truck.
It may be illegal to pass the truck.

questions.explanation: Large vehicles often go slower than the posted speed limit, especially uphill. Be careful when approaching from behind. On hills with limited visibility, passing is unlawful.

questions.question: What do speed limit signs show?

options.text: The highest or lowest speed you are allowed to drive
The speed to drive in heavy traffic
The speed to drive in bad weather

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest or lowest speed you are allowed to drive
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs show the highest or lowest safe speed allowed on a road. The maximum speed is for good conditions. You must slow down when conditions are worse.

questions.question: If you stop at a railroad crossing with more than one track:

options.text: Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks before moving.
Stop on the first track and watch for another train.
Go as soon as the train passes.
Go when one track is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks before moving.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with multiple tracks, do not move as soon as one train passes. Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks. Even with one track, check again for another train before crossing.

questions.question: A slow-moving vehicle emblem looks like:
questions.explanation: The slow-moving vehicle symbol is a reflective orange triangle. Vehicles with this symbol drive at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: If a vehicle skids on water, the driver should quickly apply the brakes.
questions.explanation: If a vehicle hydroplanes, try to regain control. If you cannot, release the gas pedal and wait for the skid to stop. Do not apply the brakes right away.

questions.question: Road rage and aggressive driving can be reduced by:
questions.explanation: To prevent road rage, use proper turn signals, follow speed limits, and allow plenty of time to reach your destination.

questions.question: You must stop at a railroad crossing when:

options.text: A flagger tells you to stop.
A stop sign controls the crossing.
Flashing red lights and gates are working.

questions.explanation: Stop at a railroad crossing when a flagger or stop sign tells you to. Also stop when flashing red lights and gates are operating.

questions.question: You cannot leave a child under eight alone in a vehicle if it is unsafe.
questions.explanation: Never leave a child under eight alone in a vehicle if conditions could harm their health or safety. A person at least 12 years old must supervise and watch the child.

questions.question: In fog, you should use your high beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams reflect back and make it harder to see.

questions.question: If a tire blows out, you should:

options.text: Avoid using the brakes right away.
Slow down gradually and pull to the side of the road.

questions.explanation: If a tire blows out, take your foot off the gas and do not brake immediately. Slow down gradually, then gently apply the brakes and pull off the road.

questions.question: You can cross double solid yellow lines:
questions.explanation: Double solid lines mean you cannot pass or change lanes. You can only cross them to turn left into or out of a highway, turn into or out of a driveway, or make a legal U-turn.

questions.question: Drivers do not have to yield to pedestrians who cross against the traffic light.
questions.explanation: You must always yield to pedestrians. Pedestrians may sometimes cross against the light by mistake.

questions.question: Orange signs are used for:
questions.explanation: Work zone signs are orange with black letters or symbols. They are diamond-shaped and warn drivers that workers are on or near the road.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should NOT:

options.text: Check your side and rearview mirrors.
Check for other drivers in the same lane.
Use your cell phone to call the police about the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your cell phone to call the police about the road ahead.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors and use your turn signal. Look for other drivers moving into the same lane. Never use your cell phone to call the police while driving.

questions.question: When you see a railroad crossing warning sign, you should:

options.text: Be ready to stop if a train is coming.
Continue driving normally since no trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if a train is coming.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossing warning signs tell drivers that a train may be coming. Always obey these signs and never go around barriers or ignore the warning.

questions.question: When turning right on a green light, you must:

options.text: Stop and look for police cars.

questions.explanation: You may turn right or left on a green light unless a sign says otherwise. When turning, always yield to other vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection.

questions.question: Leaving space between your vehicle and other vehicles is important because it:

options.text: Gives you time to react if something unexpected happens.
Keeps traffic moving at a safe speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Gives you time to react if something unexpected happens.
questions.explanation: Leave plenty of space between you and other vehicles. This gives you time to react to mistakes made by other drivers.

questions.question: To avoid fatigue on a long trip, you should:

options.text: Stop and rest every two hours.
Drive with one eye open at a time.
Change feet on the gas pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and rest every two hours.
questions.explanation: Stop every two hours on a long trip to rest. If you feel drowsy, pull over to a safe place and take a nap or stop for the night.

questions.question: What is the main danger shown by this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will be misaligned because one side of your car is higher.
You may damage a tire if you drift onto the shoulder.
You may hydroplane if there is water on the shoulder.
You may lose control if one wheel drops onto the lower shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may lose control if one wheel drops onto the lower shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If a wheel drops onto a low shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This could cause you to lose control.

questions.question: This sign shows:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Drive the same as you would on dry roads.
Keep more distance between your vehicle and others.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep more distance between your vehicle and others.
questions.explanation: On slippery roads, increase your following distance. Your vehicle may need more time to stop than it would on dry roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that traffic is entering from the right side.

questions.question: Double solid yellow lines mean you may pass another vehicle from either direction.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no vehicle can cross them to pass in either direction.

questions.question: You have the right-of-way when turning left on which traffic signal?
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can turn in that direction. Oncoming traffic must stop for you.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver cuts you off, you should:

options.text: Stay calm and move out of their way.
Flash your lights to show they are wrong.
Do something aggressive back to them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay calm and move out of their way.
questions.explanation: Stay calm and get out of their way. Trying to get even with an aggressive driver makes the situation more dangerous.

questions.question: Which of these guides drivers into the proper lanes for turning on highways?

options.text: White lines on the side of the road
White arrows in the middle of the lanes

questions.correctAnswerText: White arrows in the middle of the lanes
questions.explanation: White arrows show which lanes to use for driving straight or turning.

questions.question: When you see or hear an emergency vehicle approaching, you must:

options.text: Drive to the right and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: Give the right-of-way to any emergency vehicle using lights or a siren. Move to the right side of the road and stop. If you are in an intersection, drive through it first, then stop on the right side.

questions.question: If a bus is signaling to return to the road after stopping, you must:

options.text: Honk to let them know you are there.

questions.explanation: You must let the bus back onto the road safely. Change lanes, slow down, or stop if needed.

questions.question: You may drink alcohol in a vehicle on a public road:

options.text: If you are in the back seat.
If you are in the back of a pickup truck.

questions.explanation: It is illegal to drink or have open alcohol in any vehicle on a public road, no matter where you are sitting.

questions.question: When a curb is painted ____, it shows a handicap parking space.
questions.explanation: A blue curb means this is a reserved handicap parking space. Only people with proper permits can park there.

questions.question: After stopping for a school bus that is letting children out:

options.text: Do not move until the children wave at you.
Watch for children walking along the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children walking along the road.
questions.explanation: After the bus stops to let children out, watch for children walking on the side of the road. Always drive carefully around children.
